title: They Do Not Recognize God Within Themselves-they
summary: Attachment is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they; they do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
